title: Architecture Overview
summary: Multi-layer architecture with UI Layer (retained-mode + Phase 1 substrate), Platform Layer (win32/linux/macos), Core Layer (8 subsystems), and Z3 proof packs

title: GPU Backend Architecture (Multi-Backend Layered)
summary: Two-layer GPU design: Layer 1 Runtime Shims (~650 lines, src/core/) and Layer 2 ABI Libraries (~2,900 lines, extras/<name>-abi/); all converge through KainComponentSurface (24-slot vtable, 192 bytes)

title: Backends
summary: Table of 3 GPU backends: Vulkan (cross-platform + MoltenVK), D3D12 (Windows only), WebGPU (native + WASM)

title: ABI Paths
summary: Five Kain-to-runtime paths through KainComponentSurface: std::graphics, std::ui, surface vulkan, surface native_ui, surface shader_canvas

title: Build Gates
summary: Three compile-time gates: KAIN_RUNTIME_HAS_VULKAN_LOADER (Desktop), _D3D12 (Windows), _WEBGPU (All platforms)

title: Raw PFN Access
summary: Vulkan ABI library exposes KainVulkanPfnTable (57 PFNs) for blade-level raw Vulkan consumers

title: Precedent
summary: Architecture mirrors cuda_runtime.c pattern: shim owns catalog entry + dlopen; library owns concrete GPU calls

title: GPU Backend ABI Libraries
summary: Separately-linked ABI libraries in extras/: vulkan-abi (~2,050 lines), d3d12-abi, webgpu-abi (~870 lines)

title: extras/vulkan-abi/ (~2,050 lines)
summary: libkain-vulkan-abi.so/.dll: 43+ Vulkan PFNs, per-platform WSI, swapchain, 18 vtable slots, 57-PFN KainVulkanPfnTable

title: extras/d3d12-abi/
summary: libkain-d3d12-abi.dll: D3D12 backend with native mesh shader pipeline (ShaderStage::Mesh + Task), Windows-only

title: extras/webgpu-abi/ (~870 lines)
summary: libkain-webgpu-abi.so: WebGPU via wgpu-native, WASM browser fallback, WGSL subgroup intrinsics

title: Directory Layout
summary: Full directory tree: src/core/ (50+ .c files, z3 proofs), src/platform/ (win32/linux/macos), src/ui/ (retained + kain substrate), include/ (50+ headers), test/ (4 verification layers)

title: Core Layer (`src/core/`)
summary: 8 subsystem groups: Init & Lifecycle, Crash Forensics, Memory & Ownership, Concurrency, Compiler-Semantic Runtime, System Services, Data & Interop, Attrition & Reflection; component_surface.c is heart of surface dispatch

title: Initialization & Lifecycle
summary: Runtime bootstrap (core.c), version constants (version.c), structured diagnostics (diagnostics.c), profiling zones (profile.c), service registry (services.c), contract validation (contract.c), compatibility (compatibility.c)

title: Crash Forensics
summary: Cross-platform crash_handler.c binary-searches compiler-emitted __kain_crash_table for source mapping; no libunwind/libdwarf/addr2line dependencies

title: Memory & Ownership
summary: Arena allocator (833 CBMC proven), buddy allocator, deferred free, virtual_alloc, ownership state machine (collapse/observe/decay), fixup, handles, bitfield, union access

title: Concurrency
summary: Actor runtime (5,676 CBMC proven), async task/future runtime, fanout over OS threads, batch message queue

title: Compiler-Semantic Runtime
summary: Entangle world registry, converge multi-lane dispatch telemetry, machine_stones (axiom/pulse/shatter/teleport), wire data encoding

title: System Services
summary: Networking (net_system), process management (process_system), input sessions (input_system), graphics kernel (graphics_system), renderer backends, scene graph, CUDA PTX (cuda_runtime), SIMD detection (simd)

title: Data & Interop
summary: JSON parse/render, interop contracts, zero-copy interop, Python runtime bridge (base + async + buffers + GPU + region)

title: Attrition & Reflection
summary: Attrition certification harness, reflection payload loading, host bridge (Rust/Python/Node/C/Zig), CPU feature detection

title: Platform Layer (`src/platform/`)
summary: Platform capability descriptors (platform.c), OS helpers (os_system.c), dynamic library loader (platform_library.c), platform-specific crash handlers

title: Common Files
summary: platform.c (11-service capability descriptor), os_system.c (env, paths, directories), platform_library.c (dlopen/LoadLibrary wrappers)

title: Windows (`src/platform/win32/`)
summary: kain_win32_app_host.c (window host), kain_win32_input_host.c (input translation), win32_shared.c (helpers), crash_handler_win32.c (VEH handler)

title: Linux (`src/platform/linux/`)
summary: crash_handler_linux.c (sigaction for SIGSEGV/SIGILL/SIGFPE/SIGABRT), linux_shared.c (/proc/self/exe and environment helpers)

title: macOS (`src/platform/macos/`)
summary: crash_handler_macos.c (sigaction), macos_shared.c (_NSGetExecutablePath for binary path)

title: UI Layer (`src/ui/`)
summary: Two cooperating sublayers: retained-mode UI session (legacy node tree, hot-reload, compiled bundles, software renderer, layout, color) and Phase 1 Kain substrate (7 widget-free modules)

title: Retained-Mode UI Session
summary: ui_system (component state/events/focus), ui_runtime (lifecycle), ui_host_adapter (platform bridge), ui_hot_reload, ui_compiled_bundle, ui_color (Z3-proven div255_fast), ui_layout (Z3-proven dirty flag), ui_renderer (Z3-proven branchless), native_ui_surface (KainComponentSurface vtable)

title: Phase 1 Kain Substrate (`src/ui/kain/`) -- NEW
summary: 7 widget-free modules: kain_geometry.h (primitives), kain_surface.h (GPU abstraction), kain_host.h (vtable), kain_host_win32.c (GDI backend), kain_input (typed events), kain_font (load/measure/glyph), kain_compositor (damage tracker), kain_render_software (16 primitives)

title: Substrate / Session Boundary
summary: Additive API: substrate forwards into same abi_ui_* ABI; no breaking changes to legacy retained-mode session

title: Formal Verification
summary: CBMC harnesses (check_arena 833 pass, check_actor 5,676 pass, check_crash_handler, check_crash_handler_linux) and Z3 proof packs (140 YAML proofs in 4 domains)

title: CBMC Harnesses (`test/cbmc/`)
summary: 4 harnesses: check_arena (833 assertions, arena bounds/marker/alloc), check_actor (5,676 assertions, queue/mailbox), check_crash_handler, check_crash_handler_linux; combined sources for single-TU CBMC verification

title: Z3 Proof Packs (`src/core/z3/`)
summary: 140 YAML proof packs (Actor, Memory, Services, Allocation); 8-script Python pipeline (01_catalog to run_pipeline.py); cache for tree-sitter + libclang

title: Verification Pipeline (`test/`)
summary: 3-layer pipeline: Layer 1 Sanitizer (ASan+UBSan+TSan, seconds), Layer 2 Fuzz (libFuzzer, minutes), Layer 3 CBMC Formal Verification (exhaustive path exploration)

title: Build System
summary: Makefile for fast local dev (clang/C11), Bazel for production builds (runtime_manifest_data.bzl), 4 TOML manifests for runtime variants

title: Makefile (Fast Local Dev)
summary: 7 targets: make (compile .o), make lib (static lib), make shared (.so/.dylib/.dll), make test (ASan+UBSan), make fuzz (libFuzzer), make stress (TSan), make clean

title: Bazel (Production Build)
summary: runtime_manifest_data.bzl auto-generated by sync_native_runtime_builds.py; native_runtime_rules.bzl with platform_select() macros for platform-conditioned resolution

title: TOML Manifests
summary: 4 manifests: native_core_runtime.toml (canonical, ~50 services), native_runtime.toml (compat), native_attrition_runtime.toml (certification), native_async_benchmark_runtime.toml (benchmarks)

title: Service Table
summary: 50+ service entries across 7 categories (base, memory, actor, async, io, gfx, scene, asset, ui, reflection, compatibility, host); all via services.h/services.c with alias canonicalization

title: Runtime Tiers
summary: 3 compile-time tiers: NOOP (removed at compile time), GATED (active low-cost), FULL (full instrumentation); independent subsystem tiers (DIAG/PROFILE/FIXUP)

title: Public Headers (`include/`)
summary: 50+ headers: core C ABI (base through union) + 7 Phase 1 kain_* substrate headers + version/virtual_alloc/vulkan_loader_subset/ffmpeg_version_subset/c_runtime_math_subset/win32/wire/self_updating_ptr/ray_sphere_benchmark

title: Symbol Prefixing
summary: kain_prefix_rename_manifest.json and kain_prefixed_symbol_inventory.json/.md document systematic kain_ prefix renaming to avoid symbol collisions

title: Portability
summary: 3 platforms: Windows (MSVC/clang-cl, 11/11 services, CRITICAL_SECTION/HANDLE/VEH/VirtualAlloc/WS2_32/WinHTTP), Linux (GCC/clang, 5/11, pthread/mmap/POSIX), macOS (Apple clang, 5/11, POSIX base); base.h provides POSIX->Win32 shims
